scope: Inline source annotation extraction and clean streaming; no old candidate arrays, public or DB schema changes

runner.network: none; HTTP tests share only a --network none disposable PostgreSQL container's loopback

findings.detail: Slow downstream regression reproduced on first iteration: 541/546 characters before terminal. Changed passage channel to unbuffered so completion cannot overtake the last clean delta. Ten slow stream/save iterations and race mode now pass; not claimed as root cause of the earlier live content_validation_failed.

Old HTTP fixture prohibited banana because it existed only in the removed array; the new inline fixture places it in passage preview. Assertion now forbids the private annotation/old field, retains failure/refund/no-draft/save refusal, and avoids printing capability tokens.

Current snapshot test used a v4 golden provenance string while asserting v5. Set current test snapshot provenance explicitly before storing, keeping exact readback verification; no production reader or compatibility branch added.

First integration launch did not execute: zsh expanded the unquoted ? in synthetic TEST_DATABASE_URL. Quoted the argument and reran. A guessed routes.go lookup was absent; actual routes verified in server.go.
